---
title: "Quality Control"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
dbExecute(con, "ATTACH '../data/vpro_lists.duckdb' AS lists")
```

```{r queries, include=FALSE}
missing_required <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT plotnumber, projectid, zone, subzone
   FROM Sample_Env
   WHERE plotnumber IS NULL
      OR projectid IS NULL
      OR zone IS NULL
      OR subzone IS NULL"
)

range_issues <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT plotnumber, latitude, longitude, elevation
   FROM Sample_Env
   WHERE (latitude < 48 OR latitude > 60)
      OR (longitude < -140 OR longitude > -114)
      OR (elevation < 0 OR elevation > 4000)"
)

species_issues <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT v.plotnumber, v.species
   FROM Sample_Veg v
   LEFT JOIN lists.SppList s ON v.species = s.code
   WHERE s.code IS NULL"
)

dbDisconnect(con)
```

# Quality Control Summary

## Missing Required Fields

```{r missing-required, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(missing_required) > 0) {
  kbl(missing_required, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No missing required fields detected.")
}
```

## Coordinate Range Issues

```{r range-issues, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(range_issues) > 0) {
  kbl(range_issues, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No coordinate range issues detected.")

```

